svg.aria-label: Sync, async, batch: pick by who waits
svg.title: Sync, async, batch: pick by who waits
svg.desc: Three lanes. Sync: Converse or InvokeModel, milliseconds to seconds, full price, for interactive use. Async: submit one request, get a job ID, poll or get notified, for a single slow call such as a ten-minute analysis that no user waits on. Batch: many prompts as JSONL in S3, Bedrock processes them over hours and writes results to S3, roughly 50 percent cheaper, for nightly summarization, bulk classification, and evaluation datasets.
svg.text: WHO WAITS? THE ANSWER PICKS SYNC, ASYNC, OR BATCH
ASYNC: one slow call, nobody waits
submit -> job ID -> poll or notify
JSONL prompts in S3, results to S3
Rule: interactive capacity costs full price because it must be ready instantly. If the work can wait hours, use batch.
